methods.label: Classify the expressions
methods.explanation: Integral algebraic expressions include monomials and polynomials, and their denominators cannot contain variables. The denominator of \(1/(x+1)\) contains the variable \(x\), so it is not an integral algebraic expression; \(-x/2\) is a monomial, \(2a-b\) is a polynomial, and 5 is a monomial.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 classification of integral algebraic expressions and monomials.
